description: Reference example: keep a base image override pinned by tag and digest (BASE_IMAGE=<image>:<tag>@sha256:<digest>) up to date, and leave the plugin-managed Dockerfile to plugin releases.

customManagers.description: BASE_IMAGE=<image>:<tag>@sha256:<digest> in CI configuration, scripts or gradle.properties

packageRules.description: The ARG BASE_IMAGE default in a java-app or node-app Dockerfile is rewritten by each plugin release: update the plugin, not the line.
